title: urn:qauth:event:wallet.linked:v1
description: A wallet.linked event, version 1. A signed-in user linked a wallet credential to their account.

id.description: The event id, a UUIDv7. One event keeps one id on every route and every retry, so a receiver drops duplicates by it. It is the `webhook-id` of a webhook and the source of an SSF `jti`.

type.description: The event type, `urn:qauth:event:<name>:v<N>`. The registry lists every type.

time.description: When the event happened, as an RFC 3339 time in UTC. Not when it was delivered.

realm.description: The id of the realm the event happened in.

category.description: `user`: an end user's own activity. `admin`: an administrator's change. Fixed by the type.

type.description: `user`: a person, signed in. `client`: an OAuth client acting for itself or, with `delegationChain`, as an agent for the subject. `system`: QAuth itself, such as a scheduled job. `operator_cli`: an operator on the server host, through a QAuth command-line tool.

id.description: The actor's identifier: a user id, a client's `client_id`, or the operating-system user for `operator_cli`. Absent for `system`.

delegationChain.description: The RFC 8693 `act` chain of a delegated request, as `client_id` values: the acting agent first, then each earlier actor. Absent when nothing was delegated.

actor.description: Who or what caused the event.

type.description: What kind of thing the subject is.

id.description: The subject's identifier: a user id, a client's `client_id` or an API key id. It stays valid after the subject is deleted.

client.description: The OAuth client the request came through.

traceId.description: The id under which QAuth logged the request: the `trace_id` of a problem document from the same request.

ip.description: The end user's IP address, as QAuth derived it from the request. An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address is written in its IPv4 form.

request.description: The HTTP request that caused the event.

credentialId.description: The id of the account credential the wallet was linked as.

subjectSource.description: How the subject was resolved from the presentation (ADR-009).

rebound.description: Whether the link replaced an earlier binding of the same credential.

verifierProfile.description: The verifier profile the wallet presentation was checked under, such as `haip-1.0`.

data.description: The type's own payload. Its schema is the type's.
